full_prompt_en: A square, softly lit photographic portrait shows a young woman wearing a transparent curved face covering decorated with tiny pale flowers and green leaves. She is framed from the chest upwards against a plain deep blue-grey background, with her head near the centre and her face turned to the right in three-quarter view. Dark brown hair is smoothly drawn back, its upper curve catching a restrained highlight. The clear sheet wraps across the front of the face from the brow area to below the mouth, with a rounded side edge visible against the dark field. White blossoms, fine stems and small muted green leaves lie across its middle, obscuring the eyes and parts of the nose. Subtle reflections and overlapping translucent layers make it read as a physical covering rather than a free-floating floral crown. The lower face and softly closed lips remain partly visible through the sheet, while the chin is clearer beneath its lower edge. A white high-neck blouse fills the lower part of the portrait. Its upright ruffled collar forms a scalloped edge around the neck, and raised floral embroidery spreads across the chest with a few small green-gold details. The sleeves are smoother, with broad gentle folds and cool grey shadows. Soft frontal light reveals the fabric relief and delicate floral covering without harsh cast shadows. The blouse is distinctly brighter than the background, while the face remains subdued behind the transparent layer. Smooth tonal transitions and shallow detail soften the contours of the shoulders. The uncluttered navy-grey field surrounds the figure, leaving narrow areas of quiet space around the head and to either side. The composition concentrates attention on the unusual floral face covering and textured white collar, balancing tactile detail with a restrained, still atmosphere.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形柔光摄影肖像，一位年轻女子戴着饰有细小浅色花朵和绿叶的透明弧形面罩。画面从胸部向上取景，背景为平坦深蓝灰色，头部接近中央，面孔向右转为四分之三角度。深棕头发平顺向后收拢，上缘弧线带有克制亮光。透明片从眉部包过面前，延伸至嘴巴下方，圆弧侧边在暗底前可见。白花、细茎与小片柔绿叶横在中央，遮住双眼及部分鼻子。细微反光与半透明层叠让它呈现为实体面罩，而非悬空花冠。下半张脸与轻闭双唇仍部分透过罩片显出，下巴在下缘之外更清楚。白色高领衬衣占据下部，竖起褶领围颈形成波浪边，凸起花卉刺绣铺过胸前，间杂少量绿金细节。袖子较平滑，宽缓布褶留有冷灰阴影。正面柔光显出衣料浮纹与精细花罩，没有硬投影。衬衣明显亮于背景，面部则隔着透明层保持含蓄。平顺色阶与较浅细节柔化肩部轮廓。简洁藏蓝灰色域围着人物，在头部周围与两侧留有窄幅安静空间。构图集中表现特殊的花卉面罩与有肌理的白领，以精细触感平衡克制静止的气氛。
style_prompt_en: The style relies on cool tonal fields, softened edges and selective fine detail. Dark blue-gray space holds lighter forms through gradual value changes, while delicate surface marks remain legible without sharp outlining. Pale gray and muted white sit against navy and slate tones, creating focus through restrained contrast. Diffuse frontal light reveals texture evenly and avoids hard shadow boundaries. Fine grain and smooth transitions bind the forms to the background, while a few small details receive greater clarity and become visual anchors. Compositions often place a substantial form to one side and reserve open negative space beside it. The resulting image feels quiet and suspended, with depth conveyed through tonal softness and sparse detail rather than busy scenery.
style_prompt_zh: 这种风格依靠冷色调色域、柔化边缘和选择性的精细刻画。深蓝灰空间通过渐进的明度变化衬托浅色形体，细腻表面痕迹保持可辨，却不使用锐利描边。珍珠灰与低调白色映衬海军蓝和石板蓝，通过克制反差建立焦点。漫射正面光均匀显出质感，避免硬朗阴影边界。细微颗粒和平滑过渡将形体与背景连接起来，少数局部细节则得到更清晰刻画，成为视觉支点。构图常把较大的形体安排在一侧，并在旁边保留开阔负空间。整体画面安静、仿佛悬停，纵深来自柔和色调和稀疏细节，而不是繁杂场景。
theme_en: A young woman behind a transparent floral face covering, shown in a cool close portrait
theme_zh: 冷色近景肖像中的年轻女子，面前透明罩层上有细小花枝
name: Andrea Torres Balaguer
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
